grammar.key: The more..., the better... / 越...越...
grammar.title: 这个结构用于表示两个事物或情况以相同的比例变化
grammar.titleEn: The more..., the better... / 越...越...
grammar.usage:
这个结构用于表示两个事物或情况以相同的比例变化。第一个“the + 比较级”表示条件，第二个“the + 比较级”表示结果。条件变化，结果也随之变化。
中文解释： “The more..., the better...” 是一个固定句型，表示“越...就越...”。它连接两个比较级，前半句是条件，后半句是结果，两者是正相关的关系。
forms: 这个结构用于表示两个事物或情况以相同的比例变化。第一个“the + 比较级”表示条件，第二个“the + 比较级”表示结果。条件变化，结果也随之变化。
notes:
考试重点： 注意这个句型中的“the”是副词，不是冠词。两个部分都必须使用“the + 比较级”的形式。中考常考填空或句型转换。
Exam Focus: Note that 'the' here is an adverb, not an article. Both parts must use the structure 'the + comparative'. Zhongkao often tests this with fill-in-the-blanks or sentence transformation.

grammar.key: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.title: 当动词的-ing形式（动名词）用作句子的主语时，它表示一个泛指的活动或状态
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.usage:
当动词的-ing形式（动名词）用作句子的主语时，它表示一个泛指的活动或状态。它把动作名词化了。谓语动词用单数形式。
中文解释： 动名词（动词+ing）可以像名词一样在句子中充当主语，表示一个抽象或一般的动作概念。作主语时，谓语动词用第三人称单数。
notes:
考试重点： 注意区分动名词作主语和不定式作主语。动名词常表示一般性、习惯性的动作，而不定式常表示具体的、一次性的或将来的动作。中考常在单选和完形填空中考查主谓一致（谓语用单数）。
Exam Focus: Distinguish between gerund and infinitive as subject. Gerunds often indicate general or habitual actions, while infinitives indicate specific, one-time, or future actions. Zhongkao often tests subject-verb agreement (singular verb) in multiple choice and cloze tests.

grammar.title: 第一类条件句用于谈论可能在未来发生的真实情况及其可能的结果
grammar.usage:
第一类条件句用于谈论可能在未来发生的真实情况及其可能的结果。结构是：If + 一般现在时，主语 + 祈使句/情态动词(can, should, etc.) + 动词原形。主句常用将来时或祈使句表示结果。
中文解释： 第一类条件句表示在某种可能实现的条件下，将会发生的结果。If从句用一般现在时，主句用一般将来时或祈使句。
notes:
考试重点： 牢记“主将从现”原则：If条件句用一般现在时，主句用一般将来时（will/shall + 动词原形）或含有情态动词（can, may, must等）的现在时。中考常在单选、句型转换和完形填空中考查时态搭配。
Exam Focus: Remember the principle: present tense in the 'if'-clause, future or modal verb in the main clause. Zhongkao often tests tense agreement in multiple choice, sentence transformation, and cloze tests.

grammar.key: Passive Voice (Present Simple) / 被动语态（一般现在时）
grammar.title: 被动语态用于强调动作的承受者，而不是执行者
grammar.titleEn: Passive Voice (Present Simple) / 被动语态（一般现在时）
grammar.usage:
被动语态用于强调动作的承受者，而不是执行者。一般现在时的被动语态结构是：am/is/are + 过去分词。当动作执行者不重要、未知或显而易见时使用。
中文解释： 被动语态表示主语是动作的承受者。一般现在时的被动语态由“am/is/are + 动词的过去分词”构成。常用于不强调或不知道动作执行者时。
forms: 被动语态用于强调动作的承受者，而不是执行者。一般现在时的被动语态结构是：am/is/are + 过去分词。当动作执行者不重要、未知或显而易见时使用。
notes:
考试重点： 1) 牢记结构：be动词 (am/is/are) + 过去分词。2) 注意主谓一致：be动词的单复数由主语决定。3) 区分及物动词和不及物动词：只有及物动词才有被动语态。中考常在单选、句型转换（主动变被动）和完形填空中考查。
Exam Focus: 1) Remember the structure: be verb (am/is/are) + past participle. 2) Note subject-verb agreement: the form of 'be' depends on the subject. 3) Distinguish transitive and intransitive verbs: only transitive verbs can be used in the passive voice. Zhongkao often tests this in multiple choice, sentence transformation (active to passive), and cloze tests.

grammar.key: It is + adjective + for sb + to do sth / It is + 形容词 + for 某人 + to do 某事
grammar.title: 这个句型用于对某人做某事进行评价或描述
grammar.titleEn: It is + adjective + for sb + to do sth / It is + 形容词 + for 某人 + to do 某事
grammar.usage:
这个句型用于对某人做某事进行评价或描述。'It'是形式主语，真正的主语是后面的不定式短语'for sb to do sth'。这个结构使句子更平衡，避免头重脚轻。
中文解释： 这是一个用“it”作形式主语的句型。真正的逻辑主语是“for somebody to do something”这个不定式复合结构。形容词描述的是做这件事的性质。
notes:
考试重点： 1) 牢记句型结构：It is + adj. + for sb + to do sth。2) 注意介词是'for'，不是'of'。用'for'时，形容词描述的是事情的性质（如：important, necessary, common）；用'of'时，形容词描述的是人的品质（如：kind, clever, foolish）。中考常在单选和完成句子中考查介词的选择。
Exam Focus: 1) Remember the structure: It is + adj. + for sb + to do sth. 2) Note the preposition is 'for', not 'of'. Use 'for' when the adjective describes the action (e.g., important, necessary, common); use 'of' when the adjective describes a person's character (e.g., kind, clever, foolish). Zhongkao often tests the choice of preposition in multiple choice and sentence completion.

grammar.key: Present Perfect Tense / 现在完成时
grammar.title: 这个句子使用了现在完成时，其结构为 has/have + 过去分词 (has shown)
grammar.titleEn: Present Perfect Tense / 现在完成时
grammar.usage:
这个句子使用了现在完成时，其结构为 has/have + 过去分词 (has shown)。现在完成时用于表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果，或者表示从过去持续到现在的动作或状态。
In this sentence, the Present Perfect Tense is used, formed by has/have + past participle (has shown). This tense is used to express an action that happened in the past but has a connection to the present, or an action that started in the past and continues to the present.
notes:
中考中，现在完成时常与'for + 时间段'或'since + 时间点'连用，表示持续。注意区分它和一般过去时：一般过去时强调动作发生在过去，与现在无关；现在完成时强调过去动作对现在的影响。例如，'I have finished my homework.'（作业已完成，现在可以玩了）。
In the Zhongkao exam, the Present Perfect Tense is often used with 'for + period of time' or 'since + point in time' to indicate duration. Pay attention to distinguishing it from the Simple Past Tense: the Simple Past emphasizes the action happened in the past, unrelated to the present; the Present Perfect emphasizes the impact of a past action on the present. For example, 'I have finished my homework.' (The homework is done, so I can play now).

grammar.titleEn: Modal Verbs for Speculation / 表示推测的情态动词
grammar.usage:
这个句子使用了情态动词could来表示一种可能性或推测，语气比'must'或'will'更弱。'Could'在这里不是'can'的过去式，而是表示现在或将来的可能性。
This sentence uses the modal verb could to express a possibility or speculation, with a weaker tone than 'must' or 'will'. Here, 'could' is not the past tense of 'can', but indicates a present or future possibility.
notes:
中考中，情态动词表示推测是高频考点。记住：must（一定，肯定-可能性最大），may/might/could（可能，也许-可能性中等），can't/couldn't（不可能-否定推测）。注意它们后面接的动词形式：对现在情况的推测用'modal verb + do/be'；对过去情况的推测用'modal verb + have done'。
In the Zhongkao exam, modal verbs for speculation are high-frequency. Remember: must (very certain), may/might/could (possible), can't/couldn't (impossible). Note the verb forms that follow: for present speculation use 'modal verb + do/be'; for past speculation use 'modal verb + have done'.

grammar.key: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.title: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.usage:
在这个句子中，Staying in touch with friends and family on social media 这个动名词短语充当了句子的主语。动名词由动词+ing构成，具有名词的性质，可以在句中作主语、宾语等。当动名词短语作主语时，谓语动词用单数形式（如本句的'can be'）。
In this sentence, the gerund phrase Staying in touch with friends and family on social media acts as the subject. A gerund is formed by verb+ing and functions as a noun. It can be the subject or object of a sentence. When a gerund phrase is the subject, the verb is singular (e.g., 'can be' in this sentence).
notes:
动名词和不定式都可以作主语。一般原则：动名词作主语通常表示一般的、习惯性的或抽象的行为；不定式作主语通常表示具体的、一次性的或将来的行为。例如：'Smoking is bad for health.'（一般行为） vs. 'To finish this task today is my goal.'（具体目标）。注意主谓一致：动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数。
Both gerunds and infinitives can be subjects. General rule: A gerund as subject often expresses a general, habitual, or abstract action; an infinitive as subject often expresses a specific, one-time, or future action. E.g., 'Smoking is bad for health.' (general) vs. 'To finish this task today is my goal.' (specific). Note subject-verb agreement: a gerund phrase takes a singular verb.

grammar.titleEn: Adverb Clauses of Condition (with 'if') / 条件状语从句（if引导）
grammar.usage:
这个句子包含一个由if引导的条件状语从句：If something terrible happens。它表示主句not having someone... linger所描述的情况发生的条件。在含有条件从句的复合句中，如果主句是将来时或含有情态动词（如本句的'can'），条件从句通常用一般现在时表示将来，这被称为'主将从现'。
This sentence contains an adverb clause of condition introduced by if: If something terrible happens. It states the condition under which the situation in the main clause not having someone... linger occurs. In complex sentences with an 'if'-clause, if the main clause is in the future or contains a modal verb (like 'can' here), the 'if'-clause is usually in the simple present tense to refer to the future. This is often called the 'first conditional' rule.
notes:

grammar.key: Relative Clauses (who/that) / 定语从句（who/that引导）
grammar.title: 这个句子包含一个由关系代词who引导的定语从句：who are lonely
grammar.titleEn: Relative Clauses (who/that) / 定语从句（who/that引导）
grammar.usage:
这个句子包含一个由关系代词who引导的定语从句：who are lonely。这个从句修饰其前面的名词（先行词）People，提供关于这些人的更多信息（他们是孤独的）。关系代词who用于指代人，在从句中充当主语（本句中'who'是'are'的主语）。that也可以用于指代人，但'who'更常见。
This sentence contains a relative clause introduced by the relative pronoun who: who are lonely. This clause modifies the preceding noun (the antecedent) People, giving more information about them (they are lonely). The relative pronoun who is used to refer to people and acts as the subject of the clause (here, 'who' is the subject of 'are'). That can also refer to people, but 'who' is more common.
notes:
中考中，定语从句是重点和难点。关键步骤：1. 找到先行词（被修饰的名词/代词）。2. 确定关系词在从句中充当的成分（主语、宾语、状语）。如果关系词在从句中作主语，则不能省略，且从句的谓语动词要与先行词的人称和数一致。例如：'The girl who/that is singing is my sister.'（'who/that'作主语，不能省，谓语'is'与'girl'一致）。如果关系词作宾语，则可以省略（在非正式英语中），如：'The book (that) I bought is interesting.'
In the Zhongkao exam, relative clauses are a key and challenging point. Key steps: 1. Find the antecedent (the noun/pronoun being modified). 2. Determine the role of the relative pronoun in the clause (subject, object, adverbial). If the relative pronoun is the subject of the clause, it cannot be omitted, and the verb in the clause must agree with the antecedent in number and person. E.g., 'The girl who/that is singing is my sister.' ('who/that' is subject, can't be omitted, 'is' agrees with 'girl'). If it is the object, it can be omitted (in informal English), e.g., 'The book (that) I bought is interesting.'
